title: SSG-EG under a slow attack
description: SSG-EG with AR 0/3/10, so the whole attack sits at or above the 0x200 fold. Every case runs past the first fold that follows its attack, and every case is keyed off while the inversion flag is live.
format: level/out/state are flat [sample,value,...] change lists; a value holds until the next pair. out is Nuked eg_out already shifted back by its 1-sample pipeline lag, and is omitted when it equals level. gate is [sample,keyed_on,...].
